source: ZXNAME0000XZ’s term local memory is easy to misread. “Local” describes scope: each thread has its own local address space. It does not mean the storage is physically next to that thread’s execution units. Current ZXNAME0001XZ documentation places local memory in device memory.[1]
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 的术语“本地内存”很容易被误读。 “本地”描述了范围：每个线程都有自己的本地地址空间。这并不意味着存储在物理上靠近该线程的执行单元。当前的 ZXNAME0001XZ 文档将本地内存放置在设备内存中。[1]
